description: Derived receipts re-evaluated with corrected gates; observed metadata and raw evidence retained separately without rewriting failed outcomes. Bounded/default controls are not sustained qualification.

limitations: Acceptance probes add counters and append-only I/O; cProfile is separate.
Synthetic historical density; public simulation current scrapes.
Configured delay is separate from actual request-start spacing.
Canvas clears are observed redraws, not an exact uPlot setData count.

evaluation.method: Corrected evaluator applied to retained raw rows; observed metadata is unchanged

upstream_trace.filter: upstream completion monotonic time within resource endpoints; excludes controls/warm-up

request_work_breakdown.method: Request interval overlaps full-window upstream query completion; includes shared concurrent readers; overall warm quantiles include every request
request_work_breakdown.cold_limit: Single first HTTP-reader observation excludes JSON encoding, Nginx and browser; cold replay distributions recorded separately

browser_probe_deltas.method: Endpoint counter differences only; lifetime maxima include controls/warm-up and are not healthy-phase maxima
browser_probe_deltas.limits: Canvas clear is not exact uPlot setData; native software-rendered frames include scheduled GC and are not an undisturbed frame-continuity benchmark

cpu_increase.reason: Healthy full-range 5s baseline (>=600s after >=300s warm-up) required; combined CPU increase must be <=10

retained_heap_growth.reason: Measured endpoints and scheduled memory samples required; growth must be <=16 MiB

sustained_duration.reason: At least 3600 measured seconds after warm-up required

resource_coverage.reason: No resource sampling gap over twice the <=5s interval

metadata_provenance.reason: Complete candidate/host/source/build provenance and >=300s warm-up required

viewers.reason: Each viewer must poll across the measured period; <=30s gaps allow responses and diagnostic pauses
